# sustain Provider

Sustain's provider: a workspace's monitors, services, alerting and status pages, managed through its API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    sustain = {
      source  = "optymyse/sustain"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# The workspace's address, and an API token from Settings › API tokens: here, or as SUSTAIN_URL and SUSTAIN_TOKEN.
provider "sustain" {
  url = "https://acme.sustain.watch"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `token` (String, Sensitive) An API token, from **Settings › API tokens**: of scope `write` for monitors, services, secrets and maintenance, `admin` for alerting, clients and status pages too; `SUSTAIN_TOKEN` when it isn't given.
- `url` (String) The workspace's address, as `https://acme.sustain.watch`; `SUSTAIN_URL` when it isn't given.
